title: AFT RI v31 remediation — make closed retrieval-intelligence work production-real
description:
## Program goal

Reopen the closed `aft-ri-v31` implementation at a remediation layer and make AFT Retrieval Intelligence v1 genuinely production-reachable through the public NDJSON/CLI paths. This epic fixes scaffold-only modules, stale return paths, schema drift, placeholder diagnostics, unwired telemetry, graph/orientation placeholders, weak ranking integration, and test-protocol false positives discovered after first functional testing.

## Source references

Source references:
- Branch under review: https://github.com/Zireael/aft/tree/semantic-search-enhancement
- Existing epic: aft-ri-v31 and closed children from aft-semantic-search-export-21JUN2026-1.jsonl
- PRD: AFT-Retrieval-Intelligence-PRD-v3.1.md, especially §A SearchPlan/CandidateProvenance/Telemetry schemas and §17 warnings
- Test protocol: testing-protocol-aft-ri-v31.md
- Functional test transcript: Pasted markdown(15).md
- Review findings from post-implementation source audit in this ChatGPT session

## Current state summary

Closed `aft-ri-v31` beads claim URFK, context budget, telemetry, graph enrichment, orientation tools, ranking, and verification are complete. Source inspection found multiple contract breaches: adapters returning empty candidate sets, URFK returning stale fused results instead of enriched/reranked results, missing per-result provenance, placeholder orientation tools, diagnostics that do not run real retrieval, telemetry helpers that are not wired into search execution, and a test protocol that can pass weak placeholder outputs.

## Success criteria

- With `retrieval_intelligence_v2` enabled through the documented public path, `semantic_search` runs real FTS5, semantic, and trigram/fallback retrieval lanes where configured and reports degraded lanes truthfully.
- Returned results are the enriched/reranked URFK output, not stale pre-enrichment fused candidates.
- Result JSON includes the agreed SearchPlan, run-level provenance, and per-result provenance fields required by PRD §A and the corrected test protocol.
- `explain_search`, `why_missed`, `aft_orient`, `aft_impact_delta`, and `aft_context_pack` exercise production retrieval/graph paths and reject placeholder-empty success.
- Retrieval telemetry rows are written for actual searches with query hash default, raw-query opt-in, retention/prune behavior, and no snippet persistence.
- Benchmarks and protocol commands include required NDJSON `id`, correct config/feature flag activation, and failure gates that catch scaffold-only code.
- Final verification proves requirement-to-entry-point-to-code-to-observable-behavior reachability for every remediated acceptance criterion.

## Child graph / implementation order

1. Contract-baseline and failing integration tests.
2. Public feature flag/config activation and SearchPlan schema repair.
3. Trigram fallback adapter wiring.
4. Semantic adapter wiring.
5. FTS5 adapter provenance/exactness/degraded-lane repair.
6. URFK return-path, enrichment, rerank, and provenance repair.
7. Output contract and result schema alignment.
8. ContextBudget/PathOnly/reranker diagnostics hardening.
9. Telemetry runtime and prune command wiring.
10. `explain_search` and `why_missed` real diagnostic execution.
11. Graph enrichment and expansion integration.
12. Orientation command implementation.
13. Ranking feature production integration.
14. Benchmark and test-protocol repair.
15. Full implementation verification gate.
16. Closure milestone.

## Verification strategy

Verification is not optional. The final verification bead blocks the closure milestone and must include a requirement coverage matrix, reachability/wiring audit, test reality check, dead/orphan code audit, and exact commands/output excerpts. Code that is only referenced by tests is not accepted as production implementation.

Critical inherited PRD warnings for this remediation epic:
- Do not implement a hard query intent router; QueryIntent changes lane weights only and the body/content safety lane must remain active in auto-mode.
- Enrich the rerank pool before calling the reranker; PathOnly candidates must never enter the content reranker.
- ExactHitFloor is post-RRF Group A/B partitioning; vendor, generated, and minified files are excluded unless strict exact mode is explicitly active.
- Do not introduce a required remote service dependency for default AFT search.
- Do not accept unit tests that instantiate helpers directly as proof of production wiring.

title: Build failing RI v31 contract-baseline tests through public entry points
description:
## Objective

Create a failing contract-baseline harness that proves the current `aft-ri-v31` implementation defects through public entry points before remediation begins. The harness must fail on the current branch for scaffold-only adapters, stale URFK return path, placeholder diagnostics, unwired telemetry, and weak orientation tool behavior.

## Source references

Source references:
- Branch under review: https://github.com/Zireael/aft/tree/semantic-search-enhancement
- Existing epic: aft-ri-v31 and closed children from aft-semantic-search-export-21JUN2026-1.jsonl
- PRD: AFT-Retrieval-Intelligence-PRD-v3.1.md, especially §A SearchPlan/CandidateProvenance/Telemetry schemas and §17 warnings
- Test protocol: testing-protocol-aft-ri-v31.md
- Functional test transcript: Pasted markdown(15).md
- Review findings from post-implementation source audit in this ChatGPT session
- Existing protocol defects: commands omit required NDJSON `id`; protocol checks `.extras.urfk_provenance` while source emits a different key; Phase 4 accepts valid JSON even for empty placeholder tools.

## Scope

Included:
- Add or update integration tests that invoke the same public command path used by agents: `aft --stdio` NDJSON and any documented CLI subcommands.
- Add fixture/config setup that explicitly enables semantic search, FTS5 where available, and `intelligence.retrieval_intelligence_v2` through the documented path.
- Assert non-placeholder behavior, not merely valid JSON.

Out of scope:
- Fixing production behavior in this bead except for tiny test harness utilities required to make tests runnable.
- Benchmark tuning or recall threshold changes.

## Behavior under test

- `semantic_search` with RI v2 enabled returns real multi-lane candidates and a full SearchPlan/provenance contract.
- Adapters cannot return empty `CandidateSet` silently when their lane is active and configured.
- `explain_search`, `why_missed`, and orientation commands cannot pass with hardcoded empty results.
- Telemetry verification queries the actual `.aft/index.sqlite` database used by the command under test.

## Test reality check

The tests must fail if:
- `SemanticAdapter::retrieve` or `TrigramAdapter::retrieve` returns an empty placeholder for an active lane.
- `run_urfk_pipeline` computes enriched/reranked results but returns the pre-enrichment `fused` list.
- `why_missed` leaves `was_in_candidate_pool=false` without running real retrieval.
- `aft_context_pack` returns an empty pack and `tokens_used=0` as a successful result.
- telemetry helper functions exist but `semantic_search` never writes retrieval rows.

## Validation commands

- `cargo test -p aft retrieval_intelligence_contract --features semantic-model2vec,semantic-fts5`
- `cargo test -p aft --features semantic-model2vec,semantic-fts5`
- Public smoke: pipe NDJSON with required `id` fields through `target/release/aft/aft.exe --stdio` or platform-local equivalent.

## Acceptance criteria

- A contract test suite exists and fails on at least the known current scaffold defects before their fixes are applied.
- Tests invoke public dispatch/command paths, not only helper modules.
- Test assertions check concrete output fields and non-empty useful data where the PRD requires it.
- The harness records the required setup for semantic search, FTS5, and RI v2 feature flag activation.
- A short comment or fixture README explains why valid JSON is insufficient acceptance evidence.

## Handoff requirements

List exact failing tests and the current failure mode. The next bead should begin by running these tests and confirming the expected failures before editing production code.

title: Fix RI v2 activation path and complete SearchPlan debug schema
description:
## Objective

Fix RI v2 public activation and SearchPlan debug schema drift so the documented feature flag/config path actually activates `run_urfk_pipeline`, and `extras.search_plan_debug` exposes the fields required by PRD §A and the corrected protocol.

## Source references

Source references:
- Branch under review: https://github.com/Zireael/aft/tree/semantic-search-enhancement
- Existing epic: aft-ri-v31 and closed children from aft-semantic-search-export-21JUN2026-1.jsonl
- PRD: AFT-Retrieval-Intelligence-PRD-v3.1.md, especially §A SearchPlan/CandidateProvenance/Telemetry schemas and §17 warnings
- Test protocol: testing-protocol-aft-ri-v31.md
- Functional test transcript: Pasted markdown(15).md
- Review findings from post-implementation source audit in this ChatGPT session
- Suspected files: `crates/aft/src/config.rs`, `crates/aft/src/main.rs`, `crates/aft/src/commands/semantic_search.rs`, `crates/aft/src/retrieval_intelligence/search_plan.rs`.

## Current behavior

Actual:
- The search handler gates RI v2 on `ctx.config().intelligence.retrieval_intelligence_v2`.
- The test protocol assumes `RETRIEVAL_INTELLIGENCE_V2=true` activates the feature, but functional testing showed activation/config behavior is ambiguous.
- `search_plan_to_json` is incomplete and omits contract fields such as `prefetch`, `fusion`, `mandatory_lanes`, `suppressed_lanes`, `rerank`, diagnostics, and feature flag state.

Expected:
- One documented public activation path exists and is tested. If the environment variable remains documented, it must override or populate runtime config consistently.
- `search_plan_debug` contains the stable contract fields needed for agent diagnostics and protocol validation.

Environment:
- Branch: `semantic-search-enhancement`.
- Binary path in user test session: `D:/Coding/_tools/aft-src/target/release/aft/aft.exe`.

## Actual behavior

The public RI v2 path exhibits the defect described in `## Current behavior` above. Treat helper-only or placeholder behavior as actual behavior unless the same behavior is proven through `aft --stdio` or the documented CLI path.

## Expected behavior

The public RI v2 path must satisfy the contract described in the `Expected:` bullets above, with tests that fail when production wiring is absent.

## Impact

Users can believe RI v2 is enabled while the old path or lexical fallback path is running. This invalidates functional test results and blocks diagnosis of all downstream retrieval defects.

## Suspected area

- `IntelligenceConfig` defaulting and environment/config override handling.
- NDJSON configure path and command context construction.
- `search_plan_to_json` serialization.

## Scope

Included:
- Decide and implement the public activation contract: config-only, env override, or both. Align code, protocol, and tests.
- Emit full SearchPlan debug schema in stable JSON.
- Add failure-mode diagnostics when the flag is requested but semantic/FTS5 prerequisites are not configured.

Out of scope:
- Implementing the individual retrieval lanes; those are separate beads.

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Run `semantic_search` through `aft --stdio` with required `id` fields and `RETRIEVAL_INTELLIGENCE_V2=true` but no explicit config field.
2. Observe whether `run_urfk_pipeline` executes and whether `extras.search_plan_debug` contains full PRD §A fields.
3. Compare output against the protocol expectation for `prefetch`, `fusion`, and provenance keys.

## Implementation plan

1. Trace how NDJSON `configure` builds `Config` and `CommandContext`.
2. Add explicit tests for env var, config flag, and default-off behavior.
3. Expand SearchPlan serialization without inventing undocumented field names.
4. Update protocol fixture examples if the canonical public flag path changes.

## Validation commands

- `cargo test -p aft retrieval_intelligence_feature_flag --features semantic-model2vec,semantic-fts5`
- `cargo test -p aft search_plan_debug_schema --features semantic-model2vec,semantic-fts5`
- Manual NDJSON smoke with flag off and on; verify old path has no RI extras and RI path has complete SearchPlan fields.

## Acceptance criteria

- Default behavior remains old output with no RI debug/provenance fields.
- Documented flag/config activation reliably triggers RI v2 in public command execution.
- `search_plan_debug` includes intent, lane weights, mandatory/suppressed lanes, prefetch plan, fusion plan, rerank plan, context budget, diagnostics level, active safety lane, and feature flag state.
- Tests fail if the flag is set but the old path still executes.
- Tests fail if `prefetch` or `fusion` are missing from `search_plan_debug`.

## Handoff requirements

Record the canonical activation method in the corrected protocol and note any backward-compatible aliases retained.

title: Wire TrigramAdapter to real lexical/trigram search fallback
description:
## Objective

Replace the placeholder `TrigramAdapter` implementation with a production wrapper around AFT's existing lexical/trigram search infrastructure so the safety fallback lane can return real candidates when FTS5 or semantic retrieval is unavailable.

## Source references

Source references:
- Branch under review: https://github.com/Zireael/aft/tree/semantic-search-enhancement
- Existing epic: aft-ri-v31 and closed children from aft-semantic-search-export-21JUN2026-1.jsonl
- PRD: AFT-Retrieval-Intelligence-PRD-v3.1.md, especially §A SearchPlan/CandidateProvenance/Telemetry schemas and §17 warnings
- Test protocol: testing-protocol-aft-ri-v31.md
- Functional test transcript: Pasted markdown(15).md
- Review findings from post-implementation source audit in this ChatGPT session
- Suspected files: `crates/aft/src/retrieval_intelligence/adapters/trigram.rs`, `crates/aft/src/search_index.rs`, `crates/aft/src/commands/semantic_search.rs`.

## Current behavior

Actual:
- `TrigramAdapter::retrieve` returns an empty `CandidateSet` placeholder.
- The PRD requires `TrigramBody` as safety fallback when FTS5 is unavailable.

Expected:
- Active trigram/fallback lanes produce bounded candidates with file path, line range, score, source lane, exact-hit flags for literal matches, and enough context identity for canonical merge.

Environment:
- Local repo has existing lexical fallback used by old `semantic_search`; the adapter should reuse existing production indexing rather than introducing a new search engine.

## Actual behavior

The public RI v2 path exhibits the defect described in `## Current behavior` above. Treat helper-only or placeholder behavior as actual behavior unless the same behavior is proven through `aft --stdio` or the documented CLI path.

## Expected behavior

The public RI v2 path must satisfy the contract described in the `Expected:` bullets above, with tests that fail when production wiring is absent.

## Impact

When FTS5 is disabled/stale and semantic search is unavailable, RI v2 can return no meaningful candidates while reporting a ready status. This is a silent failure of the safety-lane invariant.

## Suspected area

- Trigram adapter constructor needs access to the same search index/path root used by old `semantic_search`.
- Candidate conversion needs canonical identity and provenance fields.

## Scope

Included:
- Wire `TrigramAdapter` to existing search index/lexical search APIs.
- Preserve old lexical behavior where possible.
- Mark degraded fallback state and lane errors instead of returning empty success silently.

Out of scope:
- Redesigning the search index or adding a new lexical backend.

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Disable or avoid FTS5 and semantic/vector retrieval.
2. Enable RI v2 and run `semantic_search` for a known literal such as `SemanticBackendConfig`.
3. Observe that the active trigram safety lane returns no real candidates under the current placeholder implementation.

## Implementation plan

1. Locate the old-path lexical search call used when semantic search is unavailable.
2. Create a thin adapter conversion from lexical result rows into `CandidateEntry`/`CandidateSet`.
3. Populate `source_lane=TrigramBody` or appropriate trigram lane, exact-hit flags for literal exact matches, and canonical identity fields.
4. Add integration coverage with FTS5 disabled to prove non-empty results.

## Validation commands

- `cargo test -p aft trigram_adapter --features semantic-model2vec,semantic-fts5`
- Public NDJSON test with FTS5 disabled/stale and RI v2 enabled; assert non-empty trigram fallback candidates and degraded-lane metadata where applicable.

## Acceptance criteria

- `TrigramAdapter::retrieve` no longer returns placeholder empty results for active lanes.
- Trigram fallback returns real candidates for known literals through the public `semantic_search` path.
- Empty trigram results are distinguishable from adapter failure; failures appear in degraded-lane diagnostics.
- Exact literal matches from non-vendor/non-generated files set `is_exact_hit=true` only when the candidate actually contains the query literal.
- Tests fail if the adapter is reverted to an empty placeholder.

## Handoff requirements

Document which existing lexical API was reused and any behavior difference from the old lexical fallback path.

title: Wire SemanticAdapter to real configured semantic/vector retrieval
description:
## Objective

Replace the placeholder `SemanticAdapter` implementation with a production wrapper around AFT's configured semantic/vector search path so the Semantic lane contributes real bounded candidates when semantic search is enabled.

## Source references

Source references:
- Branch under review: https://github.com/Zireael/aft/tree/semantic-search-enhancement
- Existing epic: aft-ri-v31 and closed children from aft-semantic-search-export-21JUN2026-1.jsonl
- PRD: AFT-Retrieval-Intelligence-PRD-v3.1.md, especially §A SearchPlan/CandidateProvenance/Telemetry schemas and §17 warnings
- Test protocol: testing-protocol-aft-ri-v31.md
- Functional test transcript: Pasted markdown(15).md
- Review findings from post-implementation source audit in this ChatGPT session
- Suspected files: `crates/aft/src/retrieval_intelligence/adapters/semantic.rs`, `crates/aft/src/vector_store.rs`, `crates/aft/src/commands/semantic_search.rs`, semantic backend/config modules.

## Current behavior

Actual:
- `SemanticAdapter::retrieve` documents that actual embedding/search wiring is future work and returns an empty `CandidateSet`.

Expected:
- When semantic search is configured and enabled, the Semantic lane returns vector/semantic candidates with stable identity, score, rank, provenance, and context metadata suitable for fusion and reranking.

Environment:
- AFT has existing semantic search behavior outside URFK. The adapter should reuse it rather than building a second semantic pipeline.

## Actual behavior

The public RI v2 path exhibits the defect described in `## Current behavior` above. Treat helper-only or placeholder behavior as actual behavior unless the same behavior is proven through `aft --stdio` or the documented CLI path.

## Expected behavior

The public RI v2 path must satisfy the contract described in the `Expected:` bullets above, with tests that fail when production wiring is absent.

## Impact

URFK cannot be called unified retrieval if the Semantic lane is a no-op. Agent natural-language queries lose the lane most relevant to conceptual code search.

## Suspected area

- Adapter needs access to semantic backend/query embedding path and vector store candidate lookup.
- Candidate conversion must avoid remote-service dependency and degrade cleanly when semantic backend is disabled.

## Scope

Included:
- Wire configured semantic/vector retrieval into `SemanticAdapter`.
- Respect SearchPlan candidate bounds and lane weights.
- Emit degraded-lane metadata when semantic backend is disabled, missing, or fails.

Out of scope:
- Adding new embedding model support or remote services.
- Re-ranking behavior, handled by later beads.

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Configure semantic search using the existing AFT semantic backend available on the branch.
2. Enable RI v2 and run a natural-language query such as `how does the reranker work`.
3. Observe that current Semantic lane contributes zero candidates because the adapter is placeholder code.

## Implementation plan

1. Identify the old production semantic search function or backend interface.
2. Make `SemanticAdapter` call that interface with SearchPlan bounds.
3. Convert semantic results into `CandidateEntry` preserving score, rank, path, line range, chunk/symbol identity when available, and source lane.
4. Add tests for configured semantic success and disabled semantic degraded behavior.

## Validation commands

- `cargo test -p aft semantic_adapter --features semantic-model2vec,semantic-fts5`
- Public NDJSON natural-language search with RI v2 enabled and semantic backend configured; assert Semantic lane contribution appears in provenance.

## Acceptance criteria

- `SemanticAdapter::retrieve` contributes real candidates when semantic search is configured.
- Disabled/missing semantic backend produces explicit degraded-lane diagnostics, not silent empty success.
- Semantic candidates are bounded by SearchPlan and participate in RRF fusion.
- Tests fail if the adapter returns hardcoded empty `CandidateSet` for an enabled semantic lane.
- No new required remote service dependency is introduced.

## Handoff requirements

Record the semantic backend path reused and any limitations of available chunk IDs/symbol IDs for canonical merge.

title: Repair FTS5Adapter lane provenance, exactness, and degraded fallback
description:
## Objective

Fix `FTS5Adapter` so each FTS5 lane reports truthful lane provenance, exact-hit classification, candidate bounds, and degraded-lane failures instead of duplicating the same planner query across lanes and silently treating errors as empty success.

## Source references

Source references:
- Branch under review: https://github.com/Zireael/aft/tree/semantic-search-enhancement
- Existing epic: aft-ri-v31 and closed children from aft-semantic-search-export-21JUN2026-1.jsonl
- PRD: AFT-Retrieval-Intelligence-PRD-v3.1.md, especially §A SearchPlan/CandidateProvenance/Telemetry schemas and §17 warnings
- Test protocol: testing-protocol-aft-ri-v31.md
- Functional test transcript: Pasted markdown(15).md
- Review findings from post-implementation source audit in this ChatGPT session
- Suspected files: `crates/aft/src/retrieval_intelligence/adapters/fts5.rs`, `crates/aft/src/fts5_planner.rs`, `crates/aft/src/fts5_store.rs`.

## Current behavior

Actual:
- The adapter loops through active FTS5 lanes but calls the same fused `QueryPlanner::search(query, max_candidates)` for each lane.
- `is_exact_hit` is inferred too broadly from symbol-like result fields instead of actual query-symbol equality.
- Adapter errors are converted into empty candidate sets without degraded-lane evidence.

Expected:
- FTS5Symbol, FTS5Body, FTS5Path, and FTS5Docs lanes either execute distinct lane-specific retrieval or truthfully report a single FTS5 planner contribution without fake per-lane duplication.
- Exact hits are exact only when the query exactly matches the symbol/literal/path condition required by the PRD.
- Lane failures show up in `degraded_lanes` with reason and fallback used.

Environment:
- FTS5 may be optional at build/runtime. The safety fallback must degrade to TrigramBody or DegradedLiteralBodyScan.

## Actual behavior

The public RI v2 path exhibits the defect described in `## Current behavior` above. Treat helper-only or placeholder behavior as actual behavior unless the same behavior is proven through `aft --stdio` or the documented CLI path.

## Expected behavior

The public RI v2 path must satisfy the contract described in the `Expected:` bullets above, with tests that fail when production wiring is absent.

## Impact

Current provenance can claim multi-lane evidence when one fused FTS5 planner call did the work. ExactHitFloor may promote non-exact symbol-like results, damaging precision.

## Suspected area

- FTS5 planner APIs may not expose lane-specific calls. If so, introduce honest provenance naming rather than fabricating separate lane contributions.

## Scope

Included:
- Repair lane contribution semantics.
- Repair exact-hit predicate.
- Convert errors into degraded-lane diagnostics consumed by SearchPlan/explain_search.

Out of scope:
- Major FTS5 query planner redesign unless unavoidable for correctness.

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Enable RI v2 with FTS5 available.
2. Run identifier and path/body queries.
3. Inspect per-candidate provenance and exact-hit flags; current adapter over-attributes lanes and exactness.

## Implementation plan

1. Audit `QueryPlanner::search` result metadata and decide whether true lane-specific retrieval is available.
2. Implement lane-specific calls or honest aggregate FTS5 provenance.
3. Compare query text to symbol/path/literal fields before setting `is_exact_hit`.
4. Surface failures as degraded lanes instead of empty success.

## Validation commands

- `cargo test -p aft fts5_adapter --features semantic-fts5`
- Public NDJSON identifier search; assert non-vendor exact symbol definition is exact and unrelated symbol-like result is not exact.
- Public NDJSON forced FTS5 failure/stale index case; assert degraded lane and trigram fallback.

## Acceptance criteria

- FTS5 lane provenance reflects the retrieval actually performed.
- ExactHitFloor only receives true exact hits from non-vendor/non-generated candidates.
- FTS5 errors/stale index states are visible in degraded-lane diagnostics and do not silently appear as empty success.
- Tests include a negative control where a symbol-like but non-equal candidate must not be marked exact.
- SearchPlan active safety lane falls back correctly when FTS5 is unavailable.

## Handoff requirements

Document whether FTS5 lane-specific retrieval was implemented or whether an aggregate planner lane is intentionally exposed.

title: Return final enriched/reranked URFK candidates from semantic_search
description:
## Objective

Fix `run_urfk_pipeline` so the public RI v2 `semantic_search` result is built from enriched/reranked URFK candidates, not the stale pre-enrichment `fused` list. This bead is the core production-wiring defect behind most downstream false positives.

## Source references

Source references:
- Branch under review: https://github.com/Zireael/aft/tree/semantic-search-enhancement
- Existing epic: aft-ri-v31 and closed children from aft-semantic-search-export-21JUN2026-1.jsonl
- PRD: AFT-Retrieval-Intelligence-PRD-v3.1.md, especially §A SearchPlan/CandidateProvenance/Telemetry schemas and §17 warnings
- Test protocol: testing-protocol-aft-ri-v31.md
- Functional test transcript: Pasted markdown(15).md
- Review findings from post-implementation source audit in this ChatGPT session
- Suspected files: `crates/aft/src/commands/semantic_search.rs`, `crates/aft/src/retrieval_intelligence/context_budget.rs`, `crates/aft/src/semantic_rerank.rs`, URFK fusion modules.

## Current behavior

Actual:
- URFK computes `hybrid_results`, enriches them, optionally reranks, truncates them, and then returns `SemanticResult` values mapped from `fused.iter().take(top_k)` instead of `hybrid_results`.
- Enrichment, rerank, context budget, and diagnostics can therefore be dead code for returned results.

Expected:
- The returned result list is the final ordered URFK output after fusion, graph expansion where active, context enrichment, ranking features, and rerank or skip decision.

Environment:
- Public path is `semantic_search` through NDJSON dispatch with RI v2 enabled.

## Actual behavior

The public RI v2 path exhibits the defect described in `## Current behavior` above. Treat helper-only or placeholder behavior as actual behavior unless the same behavior is proven through `aft --stdio` or the documented CLI path.

## Expected behavior

The public RI v2 path must satisfy the contract described in the `Expected:` bullets above, with tests that fail when production wiring is absent.

## Impact

Users see results that bypass the intended RI v2 behavior while debug fields suggest the new pipeline ran. This is a silent correctness failure.

## Suspected area

- Result mapping and ownership/lifetime around `hybrid_results` versus `fused`.
- Conversion into `SemanticResult` lacks fields required by provenance/output contract.

## Scope

Included:
- Return final URFK candidate order.
- Preserve snippets/context selected during enrichment.
- Ensure rerank skip reasons and enriched ratio diagnostics are returned.
- Add regression test that fails if the result mapping reverts to `fused`.

Out of scope:
- Adapter wiring already handled by preceding beads.

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Enable RI v2 and run a query with diagnostics and rerank/context enrichment enabled.
2. Instrument or assert that enriched/reranked candidate order differs from pre-enrichment fused order.
3. Observe current public results reflect pre-enrichment fused candidates.

## Implementation plan

1. Change the result mapping to consume the final `hybrid_results` list.
2. Preserve context/enrichment/rerank metadata when converting to `SemanticResult` JSON.
3. Add a test fixture where rerank or enrichment deliberately changes order or snippet state.
4. Validate old lexical/flag-off behavior remains unchanged.

## Validation commands

- `cargo test -p aft urfk_returns_final_candidates --features semantic-model2vec,semantic-fts5`
- Public NDJSON search with RI v2 enabled; assert returned top result/provenance matches final URFK diagnostics.

## Acceptance criteria

- `run_urfk_pipeline` returns final enriched/reranked candidates.
- Returned snippets/context are not empty when context budget allows enrichment.
- Tests fail if `fused.iter().take(top_k)` is used for final result mapping after enrichment/rerank.
- Flag-off search output remains unchanged except for unrelated nondeterministic timing fields.
- The public smoke test for `how does the reranker work` proves `plan=true`, provenance present, and non-empty real source snippets when semantic search is configured.

## Handoff requirements

Include before/after output excerpt showing that returned results now carry final URFK provenance and enrichment state.

title: Align RI v2 output contract and add per-result provenance
description:
## Objective

Align the RI v2 public JSON output contract across PRD, source, protocol, and tests. Add run-level and per-result provenance fields required for agents to understand why each result was returned.

## Source references

Source references:
- Branch under review: https://github.com/Zireael/aft/tree/semantic-search-enhancement
- Existing epic: aft-ri-v31 and closed children from aft-semantic-search-export-21JUN2026-1.jsonl
- PRD: AFT-Retrieval-Intelligence-PRD-v3.1.md, especially §A SearchPlan/CandidateProvenance/Telemetry schemas and §17 warnings
- Test protocol: testing-protocol-aft-ri-v31.md
- Functional test transcript: Pasted markdown(15).md
- Review findings from post-implementation source audit in this ChatGPT session
- Suspected files: `crates/aft/src/commands/semantic_search.rs`, result serialization modules, plugin tool schemas if present.
- Contract target: PRD §A.1 SearchPlan and §A.3 CandidateProvenance.

description:

Actual:

Expected:

The reranker may receive path-only or poorly enriched candidates, or diagnostics may claim a healthy enriched ratio while the result context is empty. This recreates the root cause PRD was supposed to fix.

## Suspected area

- Enriched count calculation.
- Candidate context state enum and conversion to reranker input.
- Old snippet code path bypassing ContextBudget.

## Scope

Included:
- Correct enriched/unenriched accounting.
- Enforce PathOnly exclusion from reranker input.
- Emit `context_exhausted`, `unenriched_candidate_count`, `reranker_skipped_reason`, and enriched ratio diagnostics.
- Add tests with deliberately tiny budget.

Out of scope:
- New tokenizer integration if the existing token estimator is sufficient within ±10%; create a discovered bead if exact tokenizer wiring is required.

2. Run search with a pool larger than the budget can enrich.

4. Current implementation does not prove PathOnly exclusion or accurate enriched ratio through returned results.

## Implementation plan

1. Model context state explicitly: enriched, PathOnly, skipped/unsupported, failed.
2. Count only candidates with actual body/snippet context as enriched for reranker ratio.
3. Filter reranker input to enriched candidates only.
4. Bypass old snippet budget for RI v2 final context selection or limit it to legacy display path.

- `cargo test -p aft context_budget_rerank_pool --features semantic-model2vec,semantic-fts5`
- Public NDJSON test with tiny context budget; assert `reranker_skipped_reason="insufficient_enriched_ratio"` and no PathOnly candidate enters reranker input.

## Acceptance criteria

- `snippet_count + unenriched_candidate_count == rerank_pool_size` or equivalent explicit accounting is present in diagnostics before rerank.

- Pass criteria require non-placeholder behavior and correct schema fields.
- Benchmarks emit `intent_metrics`, `context_quality`, `rerank_context=aft_output`, tuning vs hold-out metrics, and CI regression gate behavior.

## Scope

Included:
- Update protocol commands with `id`, configure setup, canonical feature flag path, canonical provenance key, and stricter jq assertions.
- Ensure benchmark runner instructions match the actual runtime toolchain (`bun`, `npx ts-node`, or explicit supported alternatives).
- Add negative controls for placeholder orientation/context-pack success.
- Ensure skipped benchmark phases produce an explicit incomplete status.

Out of scope:
- Large benchmark corpus expansion beyond what is necessary to validate RI v2 contract.

## Production entry points

- Developer-facing test playbook under `docs/`.
- `benchmarks/semble/pilot.ts` CLI.
- CI recall gate script.

## Wiring requirements

- Protocol must run against built `aft` binary via public stdio path.
- Benchmark output schema must be consumed by CI gate and by manual jq examples.

## Validation commands

- Run the corrected protocol phases 1-7 on a fresh `.aft` state.
- `cd benchmarks/semble && <documented runner> pilot.ts --profile smoke --repo cortexkit/aft`
- `bash scripts/ci-recall-gate.sh <baseline> <current-run.json>` with one synthetic regression and one non-regression fixture.

## Acceptance criteria

- All protocol NDJSON examples include valid `id` fields and required configure/setup lines.
- Protocol asserts canonical SearchPlan/provenance/result fields from the fixed output contract.
- Placeholder-empty `aft_context_pack`, `aft_orient`, or `aft_impact_delta` outputs fail protocol checks.
- Benchmark smoke emits `intent_metrics` and context-quality fields; CI gate fails on a deliberate >5% hold-out regression.
- Skipped benchmark dependencies are reported as incomplete, not passed.

## Handoff requirements

Include the corrected one-command smoke test and note exact runner prerequisites for Windows 11.
